answer.note: The gate confirms declarations only, contradicting the claim that it proves execution. The replacement removes that conflict.

The done summary lacks real totals, contradicting the marked claim. The replacement correctly locates totals at the top level.
The reported dependency error contradicts successful resolution from pinning only the top-level package. The replacement agrees with the error.
Running every judge call in a container sandbox conflicts with having no isolation layer. The replacement removes this conflict.
Both versions say the description mentions append_entry, conflicting with the assertion that agents never learn it exists.
Permission for rendered prose to differ conflicts with the requirement to reproduce existing prose. The replacement requires matching.
Settling on auto-redirect contradicts explicitly leaving that choice open. The replacement preserves the unresolved choice.
The target denies all body inlining despite explicit observation of an inlined body. The replacement limits omission to large results.
The target says comparisons fail on backslashes, contradicting their stated correctness. The replacement agrees that only stringification needed fixing.
Different binaries can have different compiled-in defaults. Each process using its own default is compatible with the observed protocol split.
The target permits an acknowledgement override expressly excluded earlier. The replacement consistently forbids that override.
Claiming live parity runs every CI build conflicts with the contract test standing in for it. The replacement resolves this.
